prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE asset in a square 1024x1024 composition. ONE solitary Qianxun Pagoda in Dali in 1093: an extremely slender gently tapering SQUARE white brick tower with EXACTLY SIXTEEN very closely spaced horizontal courses of projecting BRICK ledges (dense-eave type). These ledges are flat shallow brick cornices, NOT individual tiled pavilion roofs, NO upturned eaves, NO timber galleries. Tall first storey, subsequent fifteen short levels, small dark arched niche in alternating levels. Modest tiny metal finial. Square 7m x7m thin stone ground footprint. Front base edge and right base edge slope exactly +0.5 / -0.5, elevation clearly viewed from30 degrees downward. Entire tower in frame.
